package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonExampleRelationRepoPG stores semantic links between examples.
type LessonExampleRelationRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r LessonExampleRelationRepoPG) ReplaceBySourceExample(ctx context.Context, sourceExampleID string, relations []domain.LessonExampleRelation) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(relations))
	for _, relation := range relations {
		keys = append(keys, relation.SourceKey)
	}
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example_relation WHERE source_example_id=$1`, sourceExampleID)
		return err
	}
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example_relation WHERE source_example_id=$1 AND NOT (source_key = ANY($2::text[]))`, sourceExampleID, keys); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, relation := range relations {
		command, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO lesson_example_relation (
    id, source_key, source_example_id, target_example_id, relation, primary_stack, stacks, concepts
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)
ON CONFLICT (source_key) DO UPDATE SET
    primary_stack=EXCLUDED.primary_stack,
    stacks=EXCLUDED.stacks,
    concepts=EXCLUDED.concepts,
    updated_at=now()
WHERE lesson_example_relation.source_example_id=EXCLUDED.source_example_id
  AND lesson_example_relation.target_example_id=EXCLUDED.target_example_id
  AND lesson_example_relation.relation=EXCLUDED.relation`,
			relation.ID,
			relation.SourceKey,
			sourceExampleID,
			relation.TargetExampleID,
			relation.Relation,
			relation.PrimaryStack,
			relation.Stacks,
			relation.Concepts,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
		if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r LessonExampleRelationRepoPG) ListBySourceExample(ctx context.Context, sourceExampleID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	query := `
SELECT
    er.id,
    er.source_key,
    er.source_example_id,
    source_example.source_key,
    er.target_example_id,
    target_example.source_key,
    er.relation,
    er.primary_stack,
    er.stacks,
    er.concepts,
    er.created_at,
    er.updated_at
FROM lesson_example_relation er
JOIN lesson_example source_example ON source_example.id=er.source_example_id
JOIN lesson_example target_example ON target_example.id=er.target_example_id
WHERE er.source_example_id=$1`
	if activeOnly {
		query += ` AND source_example.status=1 AND target_example.status=1`
	}
	query += ` ORDER BY er.relation, er.source_key`
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, sourceExampleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var relation domain.LessonExampleRelation
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&relation.ID,
			&relation.SourceKey,
			&relation.SourceExampleID,
			&relation.SourceExampleSourceKey,
			&relation.TargetExampleID,
			&relation.TargetExampleSourceKey,
			&relation.Relation,
			&relation.PrimaryStack,
			&relation.Stacks,
			&relation.Concepts,
			&relation.CreatedAt,
			&relation.UpdatedAt,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, relation)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r LessonExampleRelationRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, relationID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	command, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_example_relation WHERE id=$1`, relationID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.LessonExampleRelationRepository = (*LessonExampleRelationRepoPG)(nil)
